changes.summary: Refresh Jina protocol evidence, correct model-specific v4/v5 task support in Python and C#, and add native text embeddings/reranking. Hosted traffic remains unverified.

shared_spec.rationale: Adds a provider-specific translation binding for existing buffered embedding/rerank operations. Normalized requests/results, accounting, routing, safety and validation remain governed by the existing shared contracts. No normative specification, released schema, inventory, frozen fixture or expectation is changed; new tests provide provider wire inputs without redefining shared results. No candidate release or qualification is claimed.

implementations.rationale: Corrects the exact v4 supported intents and four known v5 clustering task literals against the current model-specific OpenAPI; independently exercises the existing normalized text-only subset. Empty discovery and total-token-only usage remain explicit SDK limits.

Adds native Jina text retrieval, independent public controls and packaged consumers; changes Voyage reachability wording to match the shared Python diagnostic. No hosted verification or full-library parity claim.
